pr_title: Allow verbatim plan numbers only, positive framing, and tighter targets
pr_description: Verbatim numbers only**: "Use numbers only when the project context provides them directly — do not calculate, derive, or estimate figures." Closes the arithmetic-derivation loophole from #475 (HK$470M→HK$141M) while still allowing real plan numbers. Positive framing**: Replace "Do NOT include 'Controls ... vs.'" with "Save critical assessments for the review_lever field." Tighter targets**: consequences 2-3 sentences, options one sentence, review_lever one sentence (20-40 words). All consistent across field descriptions and system prompt. Section 5 prohibition**: "NO calculated, derived, or estimated figures — use only numbers that appear verbatim in the project context" Supersedes #471, #473, #475, #477.
